events.subtitle: Sings ‘Latin Louie and Ella’ — Cuban Jazz Series
events.factual_description: Blues Alley's authorized InstantSeats pages list Kalí Rodríguez-Peña featuring Daymé Arocena for Tuesday, October 13, 2026, with sets at 7:00 PM and 9:30 PM. The venue bills the program as ‘Latin Louie and Ella’ within its Cuban Jazz Series and states that it is co-presented with the Embassy of Cuba. Blues Alley identifies Rodríguez-Peña as a Cuban bandleader, trumpeter, composer and educator whose music combines Cuban motifs with jazz classicism; his official site independently identifies him as a trumpeter and bandleader. The billing itself specifies Arocena as the featured singer. No backing-band personnel are currently published and none are inferred here.

enrichment.note: Authorized Blues Alley / InstantSeats pages verify billing, date, both showtimes, venue, the ‘Latin Louie and Ella’ program and Embassy of Cuba co-presentation. Rodríguez-Peña's official site verifies his trumpet/bandleader identity. The exact Apple Music album page verifies the recommended listening. No unannounced backing-band personnel, repertoire details beyond the published program title, or scarcity claims were inferred.

sources.note: Exact 7:00 PM event page verifies date, billing, venue, program title, Rodríguez-Peña's trumpeter/bandleader identity and Embassy of Cuba co-presentation.
Exact 9:30 PM event page independently verifies the second set and repeats the published program and co-presentation details.
Artist-controlled site identifies Rodríguez-Peña as a Cuban bandleader and trumpeter and describes the Cuban/jazz synthesis central to his musical identity.
Exact Apple Music page verifies Daymé Arocena's Alkemi as a 2024 album and supplies the recommended-listening destination.

provenance.note: Date, both showtimes, venue, billing, program title and Embassy of Cuba co-presentation were verified against Blues Alley's authorized InstantSeats event pages. Rodríguez-Peña's instrumental role was checked against both the venue and his official site. Repository search found no existing October 13, 2026 Rodríguez-Peña/Arocena Blues Alley RADAR record before publication. No backing-band names, additional repertoire or scarcity rationale were invented.

en.why_it_matters: The attraction is the frame as much as the names: Rodríguez-Peña's trumpet language and Arocena's vocal presence meet in a program explicitly built around ‘Latin Louie and Ella,’ with Blues Alley's Cuban Jazz Series and the Embassy of Cuba placing the night inside a live Cuba–U.S. musical conversation. That gives the pairing a sharper reason to exist than a routine club date, and the close room should put phrasing, rhythmic lift and the exchange between trumpet and voice right in front of you.
en.trip_verdict: For a DC night, make room for whichever of the two sets fits best. The local geography and duplicate set times make this easy to build around without turning it into a travel project or pretending the opportunity is scarce.

es.why_it_matters: Aquí importa tanto el marco como los nombres: el lenguaje de trompeta de Rodríguez-Peña y la presencia vocal de Arocena se encuentran en un programa construido explícitamente alrededor de ‘Latin Louie and Ella’, mientras la Cuban Jazz Series de Blues Alley y la copresentación de la Embajada de Cuba colocan la noche dentro de una conversación musical Cuba–Estados Unidos. Eso le da a la colaboración una razón mucho más precisa que una fecha rutinaria de club, y la cercanía de la sala debería dejar al frente el fraseo, el impulso rítmico y el intercambio entre trompeta y voz.
es.trip_verdict: Para una noche en DC, haría espacio para el set que mejor encaje. La geografía local y las dos funciones permiten construir la salida alrededor del concierto sin convertirla en un proyecto de viaje ni fingir que la oportunidad es escasa.
